fields.Name: T189 - AI Model Detail View
fields.Description: Opens an AI model from the AI app's Models section and verifies its detail/configuration view renders. Confirms the model drilldown path stays intact.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) - the pinned app list is short and AI is visible without scrolling. Open the Models section, then click a model row to open it. If a preview panel appears, click 'Open Full Record' to load the full detail form. The success state is the model's detail/configuration view rendered, showing the model's fields/settings (such as name, vendor, type, or token limits) OR a valid form for that record. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI application is active and the Models section was opened
A single model's detail or configuration view is displayed, showing the model's fields/settings or its full record form
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
